title: Home lists sent pages by prospect and last activity
change: Home leads with the pages the rep has sent, one card per prospect, newest activity first. Each card says who the page is for, what they last did and how many views it has. Videos, images and documents move to one quiet Files shelf, and Learn leaves the sidebar.
evidence: 97 of 139 new customer pages in the last 30 days were made from one recorded video. The page sent to a person is the unit of work, not the file.
notes: Activity lines, view counts and send times are mock data. Page names are the prospect, as if the recorder had asked who the video is for. The page thumbnails come from the real Library card renderer. Header buttons, search, filter, sort and New folder are unchanged so the diff stays on the content.
